title: EQSIM Agent: A Conversational AI for Interactive Exploration of Large-scale Earthquake Simulation Data
problem: Large-scale earthquake simulations produce massive datasets that are difficult to explore; researchers lack specialized knowledge or programming skills to extract insights.
motivation: Earthquake simulations are critical for seismic risk analysis, but the volume and complexity of data create barriers for non-expert researchers.
method: LLM-based conversational agent (EQSIM Agent) for interactive data exploration. Features natural language querying, vision-based waveform similarity search, and RAG system for literature integration.
key_novelty: First conversational AI specifically designed for earthquake simulation data; combines querying, visualization, and literature-informed retrieval.
contributions: Conversational AI interface for earthquake simulation data
Natural language query support (text, images, videos, maps)
Comprehensive evaluation of LLM capabilities in scientific contexts
Performance and cost analysis of multiple LLMs
Practical guidance for future scientific AI agents
limitations: Abstract-only; lacks quantitative evaluation metrics, user study results, or specific query latencies
